arguments.content:
#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to DEST.
# Set DEST to either a local mounted destination or an scp destination
# (for example, backup.example:/srv/backups).
set -eu

: "${DEST:?DEST must be set to the backup destination}"

STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

if [ ! -d logs ]; then
    echo "logs/ does not exist" >&2
    exit 1
fi

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

case "$DEST" in
    *:*)
        scp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST"
        ;;
    *)
        cp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST"
        ;;
esac

echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST"

arguments.command:
set -eu
sh -n backup.sh
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
cp backup.sh "$tmp/backup.sh"
mkdir -p "$tmp/logs" "$tmp/destination"
printf 'nightly log\n' > "$tmp/logs/app.log"
(
  cd "$tmp"
  DEST="$tmp/destination" ./backup.sh
  test -f "logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz"
  test -f "destination/logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz"
  tar -tzf "destination/logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz" | grep -qx 'logs/app.log'
)
printf 'local backup smoke test passed\n'
